scope: Synthetic training-fold annotation drafts; no admission, human gold or independent evaluation
missingAnnotation: An omitted annotation field is unannotated, not semantic uncertainty or confirmed absence
spanConvention: Zero-based Unicode code-point offsets in the exact original synthetic SMS; end exclusive; exact text required
legacyEvidenceConvention: Legacy claims are weak source-column claims, located by sourceIndex and legacyFields within the hash-bound source artifact; null is not confirmed absence
decisionRule: trackingDecision is derived only from annotated canonical facts, never directly from a legacy class/type
queueRule: One hash-minimum existing training record per source expression; no model scoring or label-dependent ranking
reservationRule: Conservative lexical protected-identity/related-brand candidates block the entire frozen SMS group; no repartition or final inference
admissionRule: Every draft remains trainingEligible=false and independentEvaluationEligible=false, including reviewed weak drafts
